entries.en: Stuck on where to take my style. Anything you'd recommend?
entries.en_m: Stuck on where I wanna take my style. Anything you'd recommend?
entries.ro: Mă tot gândesc încotro să-mi duc stilul. Ai ceva de recomandat?

entries.en: Your eyes remind me of autumn. Might I suggest a piece from Chiaki Kyoto?
entries.ro: Ochii tăi mi-aduc aminte de toamnă. Ce zici de o piesă de la Chiaki Kyoto?

entries.en: I'd like to use your services.
entries.ro: Aș vrea să folosesc serviciile tale.
